SOCIAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Avoiding all community work

2. Which statement about Interdependence of people is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Interdependence of people never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Interdependence of people.
   C. Explain Interdependence of people with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Interdependence of people as rumours only.

3. Which statement about Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County..
   B. Explain Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. as rumours only.
   D. Say Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about Seasons in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   C. Say Seasons in the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Seasons in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Name the president
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Measure rainfall only

6. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nairobi
   D. Nakuru

7. Which statement about Physical features in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   D. Say Physical features in the County never happens in Kenya.

8. Which statement about The School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say The School never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing The School.
   C. Treat The School as rumours only.
   D. Explain The School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Economic activities in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Economic activities in the County never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Economic activities in the County as rumours only.
   C. Explain Economic activities in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Economic activities in the County.

10. Which statement about Compass Direction is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Compass Direction as rumours only.
   B. Say Compass Direction never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Compass Direction.
   D. Explain Compass Direction with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Hide all money underground

12. Which statement about Location and size of the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Location and size of the County never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Location and size of the County.
   C. Explain Location and size of the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Location and size of the County as rumours only.

13. Which statement about Enterprise Project at School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Enterprise Project at School never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Enterprise Project at School.
   C. Explain Enterprise Project at School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Enterprise Project at School as rumours only.

14. Which statement about Population Distribution is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Population Distribution as rumours only.
   B. Say Population Distribution never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Population Distribution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Population Distribution.

15. Which statement about Historic Built Environments in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Historic Built Environments in the County never happens in Kenya.

   A. Explain Industries in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

   C. Say Industries in the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Industries in the County as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain The County Governments in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
